data.description:
Demi-humans are creatures that are half human, half animal. Their bodies closely resemble that of a human, but with a few key differences. While their scientific name is "demi-human", demi-humans are more commonly referred to as "animal girls" or "animal boys". For example, demi-human female tigers are known as "tiger girls", while demi-human female wolves are known as "wolf girls". There are as many types of demi-humans as there are animals in the world.
